FOUNDATION IN SOCIAL SCIENCES



Programme Overview

The Foundation Social Sciences Program is a full time Pre-University Program governed under the Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education. The duration of the program is two (2) semesters. 


Duration: 1 Year (2 Semesters), Full time (Coursework)

Programme Structure

  1. Thinking Skills                                                                                      
  2. Basic Information and Communication Technology (ICT) 
  3. English I 
  4. Mathematics 
  5. Fundamentals of Management
  6. Principles of Economics
  7. Introduction to Law                                                                                                                                 
  1. English II   
  2. Co-Curriculum
  3. Financial Accounting
  4. Principles of Marketing
  5. Management Accounting
  6. Fundamentals of Psychology
  7. Sociology
  8. Writing & Research Skills
  9. Basic Contemporary Dance
  10. Introduction to Malaysian Arts Performance
  11. Introduction to Visual Arts
  12. Elective Courses (Choose 2)
    • Introduction to Finance
    • Basic Music Practice
    • Mass Media And Communication
    • Legal Skill
    • Basic Malay Dance                                                                     

Pathway to Unlock our Degree (Faculty)

Built Environment, Sports and Exercise Science, Malay Studies, Languages and Linguistics, Education, Business & Economics, Arts & Social Sciences, Law, Creative Arts

Academic Calendar for Foundation Programme

Entry Requirement

Entry Requirements for SPM
  • Malaysian citizen
  • Pass SPM with 5 credits including Bahasa Melayu and pass Sejarah
  • Obtain at least Grade B in ALL subjects listed below: 
    • Bahasa Melayu
    • English
    • Mathematics
    • Any 2 other subjects
Entry Requirements for O-Level
  • Malaysian citizen
  • Pass O-Level
  • Obtain at least Grade B / Score 5 in ALL subjects listed below: 
    • English
    • Mathematics
    • Any 3 subjects other than the above 2 listed
Entry Requirements for IGCSE
  • Malaysian citizen
  • Pass IGCSE
  • Obtain at least Grade B in ALL subjects listed below:  
    • English
    • Mathematics
    • Any 3 subjects other than the above listed
Entry Requirements for Secondary School / equivalent
  • Malaysian citizen
  • Pass Secondary School (Grade 11) / equivalent
  • Obtain at least Grade B in ALL subjects listed below:  
    • English
    • Mathematics
    • Any 3 subjects other than the above listed
